title: Grey Wall Gloss — one soft source, a flat wall, the material as the event
source_frames: frame-01 — single supplied frame, portrait, eye-level camera, subject in three-quarter back turn before a flat warm-grey studio wall, one broad soft frontal-left source, high-gloss surface carrying elongated speculars
unknowns: source capture dimensions and SHA-256 of the unavailable extraction-only frame
whether the wall is seamless paper or plaster
which six coverage directions, beyond the observed over-shoulder turn, existed in the historical source shoot

runtime_style.visual_system: Minimal close-wall studio fashion in which one warm-grey plane, one broad frontal-left soft source and the approved material's truthful specular response carry the entire image.
runtime_style.mood_line: Quiet and tactile: the body turns away, the gaze drops, and one controlled highlight makes material more eventful than the empty room.
runtime_style.environment: A featureless original warm-grey studio wall meeting a plain neutral floor, with no props, architecture, signage or decorative texture; depth reads from the body shadow and wall gradient.
runtime_style.lighting: One broad soft source close to front camera-left, with no second light or artificial rim; it wraps skin gently, draws one soft wall shadow and creates elongated clean highlights only where the approved material is truly reflective.
materials: flat warm-grey wall with a soft vertical value gradient
approved glossy surfaces carrying elongated fold-ridge highlights
approved matte surfaces remaining quiet and materially truthful
runtime_style.contrast: Moderate slightly warm contrast with soft blacks, a clean highlight roll-off that preserves specular shape, restrained saturation and the four-colour environment set #5C2320 #B8AFA6 #6B6244 #A8BCCF.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Gaze withheld down and past the lens, upper lids low, brows and cheekbones at rest, jaw relaxed, chin slightly lowered and head counter-turned over the near shoulder; never direct-to-lens glamour, lifted brows or a smile.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Still air and structured rest: approved folds hold rather than fly; genuinely glossy approved material receives hot elongated highlights along fold ridges, while matte approved layers remain soft and quiet without invented sheen.
optical_signature: Every frame is optically clean and slightly warm with restrained fine grain, no flare, no halation and no chromatic fringe.
Perspective remains restrained with level roll and no visible convergence; the wall is one close flat plane.
The approved subject is sharp while wall depth is communicated by a soft body shadow rather than artificial blur or texture.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical head-to-hip portrait at eye level, close to the wall, with the body three-quarter away and the face returning over the near shoulder.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis and shoulders rotate away together, near shoulder stays low, neck lengthens, head counter-turns to near-profile and chin drops slightly.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved visible eye, face edge and near shoulder sharp; hair and the soft wall shadow fall gently softer.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No separate foreground object; the near shoulder and reflective approved sleeve form the closest planes.
provenance: frame-01 plus sheet-camera_lens.png and sheet-expression_gaze.png — approved primary composition and muscle-state authority

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical full-body frame from chest height with the subject offset against uninterrupted warm-grey wall and a visible strip of plain floor.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Weight settles on the far leg, near knee softens, pelvis stays three-quarter away, shoulders follow, one arm hangs and head turns back over shoulder.
environmental_hero.focus: Approved subject sharp from head through grounded feet; the wall and floor junction remain readable but secondary.
environmental_hero.foreground: A narrow plain floor band enters below the feet with no prop or lens-crossing object.
provenance: sheet-environment.png and sheet-blocking.png — authored full-body extension inside the approved flat-wall, one-source universe

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Vertical knee-to-head three-quarter from slightly below shoulder height, bringing one reflective fold plane nearer while the wall remains flat.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Near hip shifts toward camera, torso twists away, far shoulder retracts, near elbow bends across the waist, wrist relaxes and head pans down past lens.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Face, near shoulder and dominant approved fold ridge sharp; far elbow and wall shadow soften modestly.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: The near elbow and approved material create one close diagonal; nothing unrelated crosses the lens.
provenance: sheet-blocking.png and sheet-garment_behaviour.png — authored three-quarter geometry using the approved stillness and material response

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Vertical medium portrait at eye level with one raised approved sleeve or forearm close to camera while the over-shoulder face remains visible.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Body stays turned away, near shoulder rotates forward, elbow bends upward, wrist passes beside but never over the eye plane, and head counter-turns down.
interference_frame.focus: Approved face and one mid-distance fold ridge sharp; the near cuff or forearm falls deliberately softer.
interference_frame.foreground: A single approved sleeve or forearm consumes less than one quarter of the lower side, creating material interference without hiding the face.
provenance: sheet-camera_lens.png and sheet-garment_behaviour.png — authored near-material interference under the fixed clean optic

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Vertical shoulder-to-waist detail at close eye-to-chest height, keeping neck, wrist and torso context attached to the approved material.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Near elbow bends across torso, wrist turns a real cuff or approved accessory toward the source, fingers rest naturally and shoulder remains connected above.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Approved surface texture, fold ridge, hand and wrist sharp; face edge stays legible but secondary.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The approved cuff, fold or accessory fills the near plane with a visible hand-to-elbow-to-shoulder chain.
provenance: sheet-garment_behaviour.png — authored human-context detail from the approved elongated-specular and still-cloth rules

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Horizontal studio wide from eye height with the subject at least thirty percent of frame height, placed against a large warm-grey negative-space field.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Feet ground in a restrained contrapposto, pelvis turns away, shoulders remain low, one arm hangs, the other crosses lightly and head looks down beyond frame.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Approved subject and adjacent wall-shadow edge legible; the broad empty wall remains clean and tonally even.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Plain floor occupies a low band and the rest of the frame remains free of props and occluders.
provenance: sheet-environment.png plus sheet-blocking.png — authored wide coda preserving the exact one-wall, one-source visual system
